name: RuneKingdom
detailed_description:
Welcome to RuneKingdom—

A thrilling, hand-crafted 2D adventure inspired by classic RPG legends. Step into an immersive realm bursting with wonder, danger, and endless possibilities. Every path you take, every quest you complete, shapes the legacy you leave behind.

YOUR STORY, YOUR DESTINY
Choose your calling—become a fearless warrior, a skilled artisan, a keeper of nature’s ancient secrets, or a humble farmer whose ambitions shape the fate of kingdoms. Forge your own path and live your unique story.

EXPLORE A LIVING WORLD
Roam through mysterious forests, treacherous deserts, and shadow-drenched dungeons filled with intrigue and peril. Each new location holds secrets waiting to be uncovered and dangers begging to be conquered.

FACE YOUR ENEMIES
Challenge over 150 unique enemies, each fiercer and more cunning than the last. Test your strength, your strategy, and your courage in thrilling, tactical combat that keeps you coming back for more.

MASTER YOUR SKILLS
Hone 16 powerful skills to shape your character’s journey. Extract precious ores from hidden veins, craft legendary weapons, command devastating magic, and harness the untamed strength of nature itself.

BUILD YOUR LEGACY
Construct a prosperous kingdom, overflowing with riches and glory, or etch your name into legend through epic battles and heroic deeds. Your choices determine whether you are remembered as conqueror, savior, artisan, or pioneer.

RuneKingdom awaits. Sharpen your blade, gather your courage, and step into an unforgettable adventure.

FEATURES:

  • Hand-crafted, immersive 2D world to explore

  • Over 150 dangerous and varied enemies

  • 16 expansive skills to master and perfect

  • Deep crafting system with rare ores, legendary weapons, and powerful magic

  • Meaningful choices that shape your unique story

Your epic journey begins now. Your legacy is ready to unfold.

Welcome to RuneKingdom!
